title: The Assay's Stamp
summary: The Assay stamps its mark on everything it weighs. Its guard-captains at the Yards carry the stamps. Tamsin wants three, so she knows the mark when she sees it.

steps.journal: The Assay Yards at Kell's Rest: the guard-captains lead every fifth lot. Put down three of them.

ready: Three of the Assay's stamps. Give them to Tamsin.
done: Tamsin knows the Assay's mark by feel now. She says it's badly cut.
